summary.text: Barb Gleim is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 199, which she has represented since December 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a farmer and business owner in the Carlisle area, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Gleim graduated from Glenelg High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland, College Park in 1985, and earned a graduate degree from Delaware Valley University in 2009.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Gleim said she and her husband own and farm Hayman Farms, a family farm that raises and sells grass-fed Hereford beef and hay.
She said she served on the Cumberland Valley School Board for eight years and as a township auditor before entering the House.
She listed her committee service as Education, Labor and Industry, Commerce and Aging, and said four bills she prime sponsored have been signed into law, including agritourism legislation.
Gleim named affordability, agriculture and education as the three key messages of her campaign.
